<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  background: #ccc;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#app-title {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: #333;
}

#app {
  width: 95%;
  height: 90vh;
  margin: 0;
  background: #d3d3d3;
  border-radius: 25px;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
}

#left-panel {
  width: 15%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

#cropped-title {
  font-weight: bold;
  background: #555;
  color: white;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

#cropped-images {
  width: 100%;
  height: 300px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.cropped-item {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.cropped-item img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
}

.cropped-item .crop-name {
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: #666;
}

.delete-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  right: 2px;
  background: #ff4444;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 10;
}

.delete-btn:hover {
  background: #cc0000;
}

#left-panel .side-button {
  background: #666;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  padding: 8px 15px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin: 5px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.05s ease;
}

#right-panel {
  flex-grow: 1;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

#tools {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tool-button {
  background: #666;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  font-size: 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.05s ease;
}

.tool-button.active-tool {
  background: #4CAF50;
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.upload-button {
  background: #666;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.05s ease;
}

#canvas-container {
  flex-grow: 1;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

#canvas-area {
  display: block;
  cursor: grab;
}

#canvas-area:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

/* Click effect */
button:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

#eraser-cursor {
  position: absolute;
  border: 2px solid #ff0000;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: none;
  z-index: 10;
  background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.crop-selection {
  position: absolute;
  border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
  background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.1);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
}

/* Naming Modal */
#naming-modal {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  display: none;
  z-index: 1000;
}

#naming-content {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: white;
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 30px;
  width: 500px;
  max-width: 90%;
  text-align: center;
}

#naming-preview {
  max-width: 200px;
  max-height: 200px;
  border: 2px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin: 15px auto;
  display: block;
}

#naming-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border: 2px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 15px 0;
}

#naming-buttons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

#naming-buttons button {
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.2s;
}

#prev-btn {
  background: #666;
  color: white;
}

#next-btn, #finish-btn {
  background: #4CAF50;
  color: white;
}

#skip-btn {
  background: #f44336;
  color: white;
}

#naming-buttons button:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}

#naming-buttons button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

#zoom-controls {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  z-index: 10;
}

#zoom-controls button {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 5px;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  font-size: 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

#zoom-info {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  color: white;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 12px;
  z-index: 10;
}
</style>

<!-- Title -->
<h1 id="app-title">Image Cropper</h1>

<!-- Main App Container -->
<div id="app">
<div id="left-panel">
<div id="cropped-title">Cropped Images</div>
<div id="cropped-images"></div>
<div>
<button id="name-button" class="side-button">📝 Name All</button>
<button id="download-button" class="side-button">💾 Download ZIP</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="right-panel">
<div id="tools">
<button id="cursor-button" class="tool-button">🖱️</button>
<button id="crop-button" class="tool-button">🖍️</button>
<button id="eraser-button" class="tool-button">🧽</button>
<button id="upload-button" class="upload-button">📤 Upload</button>
<input type="file" id="upload-input" accept="image/*" style="display: none">
</div>
<div id="canvas-container">
<div id="zoom-controls">
<button id="zoom-in">+</button>
<button id="zoom-out">-</button>
<button id="zoom-reset">⌂</button>
</div>
<div id="zoom-info">Zoom: 100% | Use mouse wheel to zoom, drag to pan</div>
<canvas id="canvas-area"></canvas>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div id="eraser-cursor"></div>

<!-- Naming Modal -->
<div id="naming-modal">
<div id="naming-content">
<h3 id="naming-title">Name Your Cropped Images</h3>
<p id="naming-counter">Image 1 of 1</p>
<img id="naming-preview" src="" alt="Preview">
<input type="text" id="naming-input" placeholder="Enter name for this image...">
<div id="naming-buttons">
<button id="prev-btn">← Previous</button>
<button id="skip-btn">Skip</button>
<button id="next-btn">Next →</button>
<button id="finish-btn" style="display: none;">Finish</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
<script>
/// VARIABLES ////

let uploadedImage = new Image();
const canvas = document.getElementById("canvas-area");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const canvasContainer = document.getElementById("canvas-container");
const croppedImages = [];
const cropNames = [];
const eraserCursor = document.getElementById("eraser-cursor");
let eraserSize = 20;
let activeTool = null;
let isErasing = false;
let actionHistory = [];

// Zoom and pan variables
let zoom = 1;
let panX = 0;
let panY = 0;
let isPanning = false;
let lastPanX = 0;
let lastPanY = 0;

// Crop variables
let isCropping = false;
let cropStartX = 0;
let cropStartY = 0;
let cropPath = [];
let currentCropSelection = null;

// Store current canvas state to preserve eraser work
let currentCanvasState = null;

// Naming modal variables
let currentNamingIndex = 0;
let isNamingModalOpen = false;

/// FUNCTIONS ///

function updateZoomInfo() {
  document.getElementById('zoom-info').textContent = 
    `Zoom: ${Math.round(zoom * 100)}% | Use mouse wheel to zoom, drag to pan`;
}

function resizeCanvas() {
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.offsetWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.offsetHeight;
  redrawCanvas();
}

function redrawCanvas() {
  if (!uploadedImage.src) return;
  
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  // Save context for transformations
  ctx.save();
  
  // Apply zoom and pan transformations
ctx.translate(panX, panY);
ctx.scale(zoom, zoom);
  
  // Calculate image dimensions maintaining aspect ratio
  const imgRatio = uploadedImage.width / uploadedImage.height;
  const canvasRatio = canvas.width / canvas.height;
  
let drawWidth, drawHeight;
if (imgRatio > canvasRatio) {
  drawWidth = canvas.width;
  drawHeight = drawWidth / imgRatio;
} else {
  drawHeight = canvas.height;
  drawWidth = drawHeight * imgRatio;
}

drawWidth *= zoom;
drawHeight *= zoom;
  
 const offsetX = (canvas.width - drawWidth) / 2 + panX;
const offsetY = (canvas.height - drawHeight) / 2 + panY;
  
  ctx.drawImage(uploadedImage, offsetX, offsetY, drawWidth, drawHeight);
  
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Store the canvas state
  currentCanvasState = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
}

function setActiveTool(toolId) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tool-button').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('active-tool');
  });
  if (toolId) {
    document.getElementById(toolId).classList.add('active-tool');
    activeTool = toolId;
  } else {
    activeTool = null;
  }
  
  // Update cursor based on active tool
  if (activeTool === 'cursor-button') {
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
  } else if (activeTool === 'crop-button') {
    canvas.style.cursor = 'crosshair';
  } else if (activeTool === 'eraser-button') {
    canvas.style.cursor = 'none';
  }
}

function updateEraserSize() {
  const scaledSize = eraserSize * zoom;
  eraserCursor.style.width = `${scaledSize}px`;
  eraserCursor.style.height = `${scaledSize}px`;
  eraserCursor.style.marginLeft = `${-scaledSize / 2}px`;
  eraserCursor.style.marginTop = `${-scaledSize / 2}px`;
}

function eraseAtPosition(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, (eraserSize * zoom) / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.clearRect(x - eraserSize * zoom, y - eraserSize * zoom, eraserSize * zoom * 2, eraserSize * zoom * 2);
  ctx.restore();
}

function saveState() {
  actionHistory.push(canvas.toDataURL());
  if (actionHistory.length > 50) actionHistory.shift();
}

function undoLastAction() {
  if (actionHistory.length === 0) return;
  const previousState = new Image();
  previousState.src = actionHistory.pop();
  previousState.onload = () => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(previousState, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    currentCanvasState = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  };
}

function getCanvasCoordinates(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: e.clientX - rect.left,
    y: e.clientY - rect.top
  };
}

function drawCropPath() {
  if (cropPath.length < 2) return;
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4CAF50';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
  
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cropPath[0].x, cropPath[0].y);
  
  for (let i = 1; i < cropPath.length; i++) {
    ctx.lineTo(cropPath[i].x, cropPath[i].y);
  }
  
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function cropSelectedArea() {
  if (cropPath.length < 3) return;
  
  let minX = Math.min(...cropPath.map(p => p.x));
  let maxX = Math.max(...cropPath.map(p => p.x));
  let minY = Math.min(...cropPath.map(p => p.y));
  let maxY = Math.max(...cropPath.map(p => p.y));
  
  minX = Math.max(0, minX - 2);
  minY = Math.max(0, minY - 2);
  maxX = Math.min(canvas.width, maxX + 2);
  maxY = Math.min(canvas.height, maxY + 2);
  
  const cropWidth = maxX - minX;
  const cropHeight = maxY - minY;
  
  const croppedCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const croppedCtx = croppedCanvas.getContext('2d');
  croppedCanvas.width = cropWidth;
  croppedCanvas.height = cropHeight;
  
  const cleanImageData = currentCanvasState.data.slice();
  const cleanCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const cleanCtx = cleanCanvas.getContext('2d');
  cleanCanvas.width = canvas.width;
  cleanCanvas.height = canvas.height;
  
  const cleanImageDataObj = new ImageData(cleanImageData, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  cleanCtx.putImageData(cleanImageDataObj, 0, 0);
  
  croppedCtx.save();
  croppedCtx.beginPath();
  croppedCtx.moveTo(cropPath[0].x - minX, cropPath[0].y - minY);
  
  for (let i = 1; i < cropPath.length; i++) {
    croppedCtx.lineTo(cropPath[i].x - minX, cropPath[i].y - minY);
  }
  
  croppedCtx.closePath();
  croppedCtx.clip();
  
  croppedCtx.drawImage(cleanCanvas, minX, minY, cropWidth, cropHeight, 0, 0, cropWidth, cropHeight);
  croppedCtx.restore();
  
  const dataURL = croppedCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  croppedImages.push(dataURL);
  
  const defaultName = `Crop ${croppedImages.length}`;
  cropNames.push(defaultName);
  
  addCropToPanel(dataURL, defaultName);
}

function addCropToPanel(dataURL, name) {
  const croppedContainer = document.getElementById('cropped-images');
  const cropItem = document.createElement('div');
  cropItem.className = 'cropped-item';
  
  const img = document.createElement('img');
  img.src = dataURL;
  
  const nameDiv = document.createElement('div');
  nameDiv.className = 'crop-name';
  nameDiv.textContent = name;
  
  const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
  deleteBtn.className = 'delete-btn';
  deleteBtn.innerHTML = '×';
  deleteBtn.onclick = () => deleteCrop(croppedImages.length - 1);
  
  cropItem.appendChild(img);
  cropItem.appendChild(nameDiv);
  cropItem.appendChild(deleteBtn);
  croppedContainer.appendChild(cropItem);
}

function deleteCrop(index) {
  if (index < 0 || index >= croppedImages.length) return;
  
  // Remove from arrays
  croppedImages.splice(index, 1);
  cropNames.splice(index, 1);
  
  // Rebuild the entire panel to fix indices
  const croppedContainer = document.getElementById('cropped-images');
  croppedContainer.innerHTML = '';
  
  // Re-add all remaining crops with correct indices
  for (let i = 0; i < croppedImages.length; i++) {
    const cropItem = document.createElement('div');
    cropItem.className = 'cropped-item';
    
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = croppedImages[i];
    
    const nameDiv = document.createElement('div');
    nameDiv.className = 'crop-name';
    nameDiv.textContent = cropNames[i];
    
    const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
    deleteBtn.className = 'delete-btn';
    deleteBtn.innerHTML = '×';
    deleteBtn.onclick = () => deleteCrop(i);
    
    cropItem.appendChild(img);
    cropItem.appendChild(nameDiv);
    cropItem.appendChild(deleteBtn);
    croppedContainer.appendChild(cropItem);
  }
}

function openNamingModal() {
  if (croppedImages.length === 0) {
    alert("No crops to name.");
    return;
  }
  
  currentNamingIndex = 0;
  isNamingModalOpen = true;
  document.getElementById('naming-modal').style.display = 'block';
  updateNamingModal();
}

function updateNamingModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('naming-modal');
  const preview = document.getElementById('naming-preview');
  const input = document.getElementById('naming-input');
  const counter = document.getElementById('naming-counter');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev-btn');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-btn');
  const finishBtn = document.getElementById('finish-btn');
  
  // Update preview and counter
  preview.src = croppedImages[currentNamingIndex];
  input.value = cropNames[currentNamingIndex];
  counter.textContent = `Image ${currentNamingIndex + 1} of ${croppedImages.length}`;
  
  // Update button states
  prevBtn.disabled = currentNamingIndex === 0;
  
  if (currentNamingIndex === croppedImages.length - 1) {
    nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
    finishBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
  } else {
    nextBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
    finishBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }
  
  // Focus input
  input.focus();
  input.select();
}

function saveCurrentName() {
  const input = document.getElementById('naming-input');
  const name = input.value.trim() || `Crop ${currentNamingIndex + 1}`;
  cropNames[currentNamingIndex] = name;
  
  // Update the display in the left panel
  const cropItems = document.querySelectorAll('.cropped-item');
  if (cropItems[currentNamingIndex]) {
    const nameDiv = cropItems[currentNamingIndex].querySelector('.crop-name');
    nameDiv.textContent = name;
  }
}

function closeNamingModal() {
  isNamingModalOpen = false;
  document.getElementById('naming-modal').style.display = 'none';
}

async function downloadAllAsZip() {
  if (croppedImages.length === 0) {
    alert("No cropped images to download.");
    return;
  }

  const zip = new JSZip();
  
  for (let i = 0; i < croppedImages.length; i++) {
    const dataURL = croppedImages[i];
    const name = cropNames[i] || `Crop ${i + 1}`;
    
    const response = await fetch(dataURL);
    const blob = await response.blob();
    
    const filename = `${name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-_]/g, '_')}.png`;
    zip.file(filename, blob);
  }
  
  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({type: "blob"});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
  
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = "cropped_images.zip";
  a.click();
  
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

/// LISTENERS ///

// Upload
document.getElementById("upload-button").onclick = () => {
  document.getElementById("upload-input").click();
};

document.getElementById("upload-input").onchange = (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (ev) => {
    uploadedImage.src = ev.target.result;
    uploadedImage.onload = () => {
      zoom = 1;
      panX = 0;
      panY = 0;
      currentCanvasState = null;
      resizeCanvas();
      updateZoomInfo();
    };
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
};

// Tool buttons
document.getElementById("cursor-button").onclick = () => {
  setActiveTool("cursor-button");
  eraserCursor.style.display = "none";
};

document.getElementById("crop-button").onclick = () => {
  setActiveTool("crop-button");
  eraserCursor.style.display = "none";
  cropPath = [];
  isCropping = false;
};

document.getElementById("eraser-button").onclick = () => {
  setActiveTool("eraser-button");
  eraserCursor.style.display = "block";
  updateEraserSize();
};

// Zoom controls
document.getElementById("zoom-in").onclick = () => {
  zoom = Math.min(zoom * 1.2, 5);
  redrawCanvas();
  updateZoomInfo();
  updateEraserSize();
};

document.getElementById("zoom-out").onclick = () => {
  zoom = Math.max(zoom / 1.2, 0.1);
  redrawCanvas();
  updateZoomInfo();
  updateEraserSize();
};

document.getElementById("zoom-reset").onclick = () => {
  zoom = 1;
  panX = 0;
  panY = 0;
  redrawCanvas();
  updateZoomInfo();
  updateEraserSize();
};

// Naming modal
document.getElementById("name-button").onclick = openNamingModal;

document.getElementById("prev-btn").onclick = () => {
  saveCurrentName();
  currentNamingIndex = Math.max(0, currentNamingIndex - 1);
  updateNamingModal();
};

document.getElementById("next-btn").onclick = () => {
  saveCurrentName();
  currentNamingIndex = Math.min(croppedImages.length - 1, currentNamingIndex + 1);
  updateNamingModal();
};

document.getElementById("skip-btn").onclick = () => {
  if (currentNamingIndex < croppedImages.length - 1) {
    currentNamingIndex++;
    updateNamingModal();
  } else {
    closeNamingModal();
  }
};

document.getElementById("finish-btn").onclick = () => {
  saveCurrentName();
  closeNamingModal();
};

// Allow Enter key to proceed in naming modal
document.getElementById("naming-input").onkeydown = (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Enter") {
    if (currentNamingIndex < croppedImages.length - 1) {
      document.getElementById("next-btn").click();
    } else {
      document.getElementById("finish-btn").click();
    }
  }
};

// Download
document.getElementById("download-button").onclick = downloadAllAsZip;

// Canvas mouse events
canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();

  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left);
  const mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top);

  const zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
  const newZoom = Math.min(Math.max(zoom * zoomFactor, 1), 5);

  // Adjust pan to keep zoom centered on mouse
  const zoomChange = newZoom / zoom;
  panX -= (mouseX - panX) * (zoomChange - 1);
  panY -= (mouseY - panY) * (zoomChange - 1);

  zoom = newZoom;
  redrawCanvas();
  updateZoomInfo();
});

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  if (activeTool === "eraser-button") {
    eraserCursor.style.left = `${e.clientX}px`;
    eraserCursor.style.top = `${e.clientY}px`;
    if (isErasing) {
      eraseAtPosition(e);
    }
  } else if (activeTool === "cursor-button" && isPanning) {
    const deltaX = e.clientX - lastPanX;
    const deltaY = e.clientY - lastPanY;
    panX += deltaX / zoom;
    panY += deltaY / zoom;
    lastPanX = e.clientX;
    lastPanY = e.clientY;
    redrawCanvas();
  } else if (activeTool === "crop-button" && isCropping) {
    const coords = getCanvasCoordinates(e);
    cropPath.push(coords);
    ctx.putImageData(currentCanvasState, 0, 0);
    drawCropPath();
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  if (activeTool === "eraser-button") {
    saveState();
    isErasing = true;
    eraseAtPosition(e);
  } else if (activeTool === "cursor-button") {
    isPanning = true;
    lastPanX = e.clientX;
    lastPanY = e.clientY;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  } else if (activeTool === "crop-button") {
    const coords = getCanvasCoordinates(e);
    isCropping = true;
    cropPath = [coords];
    cropStartX = coords.x;
    cropStartY = coords.y;
    currentCanvasState = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
  if (activeTool === "eraser-button") {
    isErasing = false;
    currentCanvasState = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  } else if (activeTool === "cursor-button") {
    isPanning = false;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
  } else if (activeTool === "crop-button" && isCropping) {
    isCropping = false;
    if (cropPath.length > 2) {
      cropPath.push({x: cropStartX, y: cropStartY});
      ctx.putImageData(currentCanvasState, 0, 0);
      drawCropPath();
      setTimeout(() => {
        cropSelectedArea();
        cropPath = [];
        redrawCanvas();
      }, 500);
    }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
  isErasing = false;
  isPanning = false;
  isCropping = false;
  if (activeTool === "cursor-button") {
    canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
  }
});

// Keyboard shortcuts
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (isNamingModalOpen) return; // Don't interfere with naming modal
  
  if (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
    e.preventDefault();
    undoLastAction();
  }

  if (activeTool === "eraser-button") {
    if (e.key === "+" || e.key === "=") {
      eraserSize = Math.min(eraserSize + 5, 100);
      updateEraserSize();
    } else if (e.key === "-") {
      eraserSize = Math.max(eraserSize - 5, 5);
      updateEraserSize();
    }
  }
});

// Window resize
window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  resizeCanvas();
  setActiveTool("cursor-button");
});
</script>
